title: Trade to Evolve
competitors: Loomian Legacy (Llama Train) – 909M visits since 2015, has trade-evolutions (Kabunga, Craytal etc.) as a side feature – Rolimons/loomian fandom Sep 2026; Adopt Me 40.8B (trading hub, no trade-evo) – Wikipedia Nov 2025; Pets Go trading plaza, Pets Trading – roblox.com; no game found where hand-offs are the evolution step
demand_check: unverified: Pokemon Pokopia/Champions dates not re-checked; trade-evo appetite only evidenced inside Loomian Legacy
red_flags: 'evolve-and-run scams are the gameplay' openly rewards scamming kids in trades — moderation/reputation risk on Roblox; trading UI must be scam-safe
why: The trade-triggered evolution is only a minor feature in a 909M-visit mon game, but building a loop whose core friction is scamming children is not shippable as written.
pivot: Replace ownership transfer with a 5-minute 'lend' that auto-returns: strangers must hold your pet to evolve it (three different holders for stage 3) but can never keep it, so the social loop stays and scams are impossible.

title: Run the Agility Course
competitors: The Dog Obstacle Course (Woof67, 2016, obby as a dog) – 23.5M visits – Rolimons Sep 2026; Obby but u're a dog (2023) – 8.1M – Rolimons; Dog Race (Zoo Race Club, Jun 18 2026, straight auto-race) – 28.15M – Rolimons Sep 2026; Pet Racer Simulator (2023) – 35.6M – Rolimons; no handler-controlled agility game found
demand_check: verified: Prove-It (Border Collie, Amber McCune) won 2026 Westminster Masters Agility, 29.81s clean run – AKC/Fox Sports Feb 2026
red_flags: shoulder-angle/arm-signal steering with delay is unreadable on mobile touch and hard to tune; duplicate of PMX-025 in this batch
why: Lane is open and demand is real, but body-position handling is a physics/tuning sink for a solo dev and PMX-025 covers the same idea with a more buildable control scheme.
pivot: Merge into PMX-025: replace body-position steering with timed command taps and adopt its player-built courses; keep this idea's daily rotating course and ghost runs.

title: Foster the Returned Dogs
competitors: Rescue Pets! (I am Sammy, Jun 24 2026: find scared pets, earn trust, rehome to rank up) – 10.8M visits – Rolimons Sep 2026; Animal Hospital (Anomaly) (May 2026, horror vet, different loop) – 2.36B visits / 1.27M peak CCU – Rolimons Sep 2026; Robloxian Animal Shelter RP, Rescue Animals – roblox.com; no player-to-player adoption with returns found
demand_check: verified: shelter/rescue lane alive (Rescue Pets 10.8M in 3 months; The Cat Shelter 59.6M since Apr 28 2026, though that one is an escape game)
red_flags: 'trauma trait' framing is mildly dark for the audience — call them 'habits'; adopters must have an NPC fallback or the return loop starves in small servers
why: Rescue Pets proves the rehab-and-rehome loop, and nobody has the reversible player-to-player adoption that makes strangers' neglect your D1 return hook.

title: Beg for Table Scraps
competitors: Be a Beggar! (Silly Sloths, Jul 31 2025, human begging progression) – 32.3M visits – Rolimons Sep 2026; Be a pet or adopt a pet! (RP) – roblox.com; Animal Restaurant (Anomaly), Pet Cafe Tycoon – roblox.com; no beg-vs-diner PvP found
demand_check: unverified: no evidence supplied and no search spent on begging-dog clip volume
red_flags: needs both diners and pets in every round with no bot fallback; round-based party format earns ~18% of collection games
why: Funny and unoccupied, but as a pure round-based party game with player diners it is low-money and dies in empty servers.
pivot: Make it 'Be a Beggar as the dog': NPC diners with resist AI and a will bar drive a progression/collection loop (breeds = combo kits), with player diners as an optional bonus mode.

title: Stock the Honesty Egg Box
competitors: Chicken Farm (Skandi, May 23 2026, buy chickens→eggs→cash→merge) – 113.3M visits / 123.8K peak CCU – Rolimons Sep 2026; Chicken Life (Talewind, 2020) – 87.3M – Rolimons; Steal a Chicken, Steal a Chicken Egg to Fight, Chicken (steal egg and run) – roblox.com; no unmanned-shop/theft-choice or server price index found
demand_check: verified: ~11M US households kept chickens in 2025 vs 5.8M in 2018; eggs $6.23/doz Mar 2025 → $2.19 May 2026 – WNG/Yahoo/NPR 2026
red_flags: theft option sits next to the TAKEN Steal-a-X lane; thief reputation can become a grief loop — cap theft per player per day
why: Chicken demand is proven at 124K CCU and the honesty-box choice plus a shared egg-price index is a real social mechanic no chicken game has.

title: Win the Ugly Dog Contest

title: Discipline the Chaos Puppy
competitors: BAD DOG (CattyApps, 2022, walk without breaking things) – 25.0M visits, peak CCU 1,150 May 2024, 93 past 30d – Rolimons Sep 2026; Puppy Game – 86.1M visits – Rolimons; Train Dog to Fight – removed from Roblox May 2026 – Rolimons; no obedience-vs-trust training game found
demand_check: unverified: TikTok dog-trend claim not checked; BAD DOG's 25M shows appetite for misbehaving-dog comedy
red_flags: none major; avoid anything reading as punishing animals (no hitting) — 'no', redirect, crate only
why: Misbehaving-dog comedy has 25M+86M visit precedents but the two-meter discipline loop with overnight house damage is unoccupied and cheap to build.

title: Pet-Sit a Stranger's Pet
competitors: Animal Daycare (Anomaly) (Aug 14 2026, horror shift, not sitting) – 8.0M visits / 16.1K players – Rolimons Sep 2026; Twilight Daycare RP (2021) – 2.84B visits – Rolimons; PET PARTY RP (2022) – 500M – Rolimons; Clean the Animal Daycare! – 5.8M / 8.9K CCU – Rolimons; no game where you sit other players' real pets while they are offline
demand_check: verified: daycare/pet-care RP lane is huge (Twilight Daycare 2.84B); Rover marketplace exists
red_flags: a stranger lowering YOUR pet's stats is a grief vector; cross-player persistent pet state is DataStore-heavy for a solo dev
why: The asynchronous stranger-sitting idea is fresh, but negative consequences on the owner's pet turn it into a grief tool.
pivot: Make outcomes positive-only for owners (good sits grant buffs, bad sits only hurt the sitter's rating and pay), so reputation still matters without letting strangers damage your pet.

title: Raise a Bloodline
competitors: Random Pets World (Frost Pixel, DNA-combining genetics) – visits n/a – roblox fandom; Club Roblox pets age 0→10 but never die; Adopt Me 40.8B pets cannot die – Quora/Wikipedia; no finite-lifespan/family-tree pet game found on Roblox
demand_check: unverified: Tamagotchi 100M+ figure not re-checked; Tamagotchi Paradise activity confirmed via Kotaku 2026 death-bug story
red_flags: pet death upsets young players (Adopt Me deliberately has none) — frame as 'retiring to the meadow' and sell lifespan extensions carefully
why: Finite lifespans plus a friend-linked family tree is genuinely absent from Roblox pets and turns loss into the strongest painkiller consumable.
